By default failed packets are discarded. 2 - Loose mode as defined in RFC3704 Loose Reverse Path Each incoming packet’s source address is also tested against the FIB and if the source address is not reachable via any interface the packet check will fail. The default route is missing from pc1's routing table. This indicates that there is no route to the default gateway.
The default route is missing from pc2's routing table. This indicates that there is no route to the default gateway.
The IP address 10.0.2.10 is missing from pc2's routing table. This indicates that there is no route to the default gateway.
The firewall is configured to drop packets forwarded from eth0 to eth1. This indicates that there is a firewall rule that is blocking the traffic.
